notes: Digital SAT Geometry and Trigonometry has four official skill families: area and volume; lines, angles, and triangles; right triangles and trigonometry; circles.

MathMaster's Geometry course is currently planned and does not yet have an active G.* TEKS registry. V2.1 therefore authors these four SAT skill families as native SAT banks instead of fabricating active Geometry TEKS alignments.
Grade 6-8 geometry TEKS remain valuable prerequisite/remediation nodes, but College Board's Texas report aligns those grades to PSAT 8/9 rather than directly to SAT.
When MathMaster activates its Geometry course and real G.* standards registry, the native SAT families can be crosswalked to those standards without rewriting the assessment content.

A.2E.reason: College Board Table 25 aligns the parallel-line equation standard to SAT Algebra, not Geometry and Trigonometry.

A.2F.reason: College Board Table 25 aligns the perpendicular-line equation standard to SAT Algebra, not Geometry and Trigonometry.

A2.4B.reason: College Board Table 26 marks the parabola focus/directrix standard under Advanced Math rather than Geometry and Trigonometry. It remains a separate Advanced Math construct-level review item.

allowed: area, perimeter, surface area, and volume
scale factors and their effects on lengths, areas, and volumes
parallel lines cut by a transversal
scale factor effects on lengths while preserving angle measures
sine, cosine, and tangent in right triangles
sine and cosine of complementary angles
radii, diameters, tangents, central and inscribed angles
unit-circle relationships when appropriate to the SAT construct
